claims.summary: Arrival cadence and connection reliability do not by themselves describe the topology or lived texture of a high-entropy spectral field.
claims.disposition: Preserve the distinction and verify the schema keeps delivery and structural evidence as separate typed facts.

claims.summary: Entropy, density gradient, mode packing, pressure source, lambda gaps, and cadence shape should be jointly reviewable without becoming a felt score.
claims.disposition: Verify existing bounded telemetry, fingerprint, pressure, denominator, and cadence fields plus epistemic no-causation boundaries.

claims.summary: A companion structural state should make the shape of the cascade visible beyond reliable arrival timing.
claims.disposition: Identify the current SpectralTelemetry and companion evidence records as the existing implementation; no new felt-state scalar is introduced.
